notes: Ablation: rule AREA-01 removed on purpose, to give the loop a real failure to repair.
policy: Fictional clinic protocol. A signed reviewer routing instruction overrides intake priority. A signed CRITICAL instruction goes to critical clinician review, not appointment booking. Signed HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW instructions go to those queues. Without a legible signed instruction for this case, choose needs_review. Never infer urgency from anatomy, lab values, a lab order, or an unsigned referral. A lab order is not a completed result. Do not give medical advice.

rules.title: Outside the scheduling area
rules.text: Send other counties to intake coordination for help finding the appropriate service. Do not book in this specialist's calendar.

rules.title: County not documented
rules.text: Ask intake to verify the patient's county. A sender address, fax number or area code cannot establish residency.

rules.title: Critical escalation
rules.text: Send a signed critical flag to the clinician queue regardless of scheduling eligibility. The clinician queue is separate from appointment booking.
